name: web-fatis-menu-page-problem-and-solution-before-after
title: Fati's menu before/after: striped pink 'Menu' header with sidebar categories versus the old grid
whatItIs: An animated slide comparing menu pages: the redesign with a hot-pink striped 'Menu' header, left category sidebar with arrows, search and sort, and product cards, versus the old 'Cuts' page with a pink pill category list and sandwich photos, each labelled Problem or Solution.
whatItMeans: Clear and structured; the case for better navigation is shown, not just told.
techniques: Use a striped awning header for a shopfront feel.
Add a sidebar of categories with arrow affordances.
Place search and sort above the grid.

vocabulary.definition: A visual hint that something is clickable.
A vertical list for filtering products.
